services.name: School Programs
services.desc: Explore Education at Historic Ephrata Cloister We offer engaging and immersive educational experiences tailored for students of all ages. Our two main programs-Discovery School Tours and Community School Day-provide opportunities to connect with history in meaningful, hands-on ways. If you’re considering a field trip to Historic Ephrata Cloister, make the most of your visit by attending Community School Day. For the same cost as a regular school tour, your students will enjoy extra hands-on experiences, interactive learning stations, and access to multiple historic buildings with interpreters bringing history to life.
